reading.title: The Impact of Urban Green Spaces
reading.passage: Urban green spaces such as parks and gardens play a crucial role in improving city residents' quality of life. These areas provide essential benefits including air quality improvement, temperature regulation, and mental health support. Studies have shown that people living near parks experience lower stress levels and better overall well-being. Furthermore, green spaces encourage physical activity and social interaction among community members. As cities continue to expand, protecting and developing these natural areas becomes increasingly important for sustainable urban development.

questions.q: According to the passage, what are green spaces primarily beneficial for?
options: B) Improving air quality and mental health
questions.explanation: 본문에서 green spaces는 공기 질 개선, 온도 조절, 정신 건강 지원을 제공한다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage imply about people living near parks?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '공원 근처에 사는 사람들은 더 낮은 스트레스 수준과 더 나은 전반적인 웰빙을 경험한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit of urban green spaces?
questions.explanation: 소음 감소(Noise reduction)는 본문에서 언급되지 않습니다. 공기 질 개선, 정신 건강, 신체 활동 장려는 모두 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement that cities should prioritize developing green spaces over building new infrastructure like roads and buildings?

structure.intro: 자신의 입장을 명확히 제시하세요. 예: 'I agree that cities should prioritize green spaces because...' 또는 'I disagree because...'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유: 녹지의 환경적/건강상 이점을 구체적인 예시와 함께 제시하세요
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유: 기반 시설의 필요성도 인정하면서, 균형 있는 접근 방식을 제안하거나 녹지 우선의 정당성을 재강조하세요
structure.conclusion: 전체 논의를 요약하고 입장을 재확인하며, 미래의 도시 계획에 대한 희망을 표현하세요

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer spending leisure time in outdoor natural environments like parks and forests. Others prefer indoor activities like visiting museums or watching movies. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: One reason is that outdoor activities...
sample_points: 자연환경에서의 신체활동은 건강을 증진시키고 스트레스를 감소시킵니다. 공원에서의 산책이나 등산은 정신 건강에 긍정적인 영향을 미칩니다.
실내활동은 날씨에 관계없이 즐길 수 있고, 문화 활동을 통해 지식을 얻을 수 있습니다. 박물관 방문은 역사와 예술을 배우는 기회를 제공합니다.

listening.title: Student-Professor Conversation About Research Projects
listening.script: Student: Professor Johnson, I wanted to discuss my research project on renewable energy. I'm having trouble deciding between solar and wind energy as my focus. Professor: That's a great question. Both are important, but they have different applications. Solar energy works well in sunny regions with good infrastructure, while wind energy is more efficient in coastal and elevated areas. Student: I see. Which one do you think would have a bigger impact on reducing carbon emissions? Professor: Actually, that depends on the location. In coastal areas, wind farms can generate massive amounts of electricity with minimal environmental impact. However, in desert regions, solar panels are incredibly efficient. I'd suggest you consider both options and perhaps focus on a specific geographic region. Student: That makes sense. Maybe I should research how these technologies complement each other in a hybrid system. Professor: Excellent idea! That would make your project more comprehensive and realistic.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the conversation?
options: A) The professor is grading the student's research project
B) The student is seeking advice on choosing a research focus
C) The professor is explaining renewable energy to the class
D) The student is complaining about the difficulty of the project
questions.explanation: 학생이 교수님께 신재생 에너지 연구 주제 선택에 대해 조언을 구하는 것이 대화의 중심입니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, which location is most suitable for wind energy?
questions.explanation: 교수님이 '풍력 에너지는 해안 지역과 고지대에서 더 효율적이라'고 명확히 설명했습니다.

questions.q: What does the student decide to do at the end of the conversation?
options: B) Research how solar and wind work together in a hybrid system
D) Focus only on coastal regions
questions.explanation: 학생이 '이 기술들이 하이브리드 시스템에서 어떻게 서로 보완하는지 연구하는 것'을 제안했고, 교수님이 이를 좋은 아이디어라고 승인했습니다.
